_comment: Which per-framework guides exist on the 1.0 line, keyed by the feature names `bridge guide <framework> <feature>` takes (the file stems under mcp/ on each plugin's v1 branch). CLI 1.0's `bridge guide list` and the new Bridge MCP server read it from bridge-cli/v1/bridge-cli/prompts/guide-coverage.json. Only frameworks with a 1.0 plugin are listed; `javascript` is auth-core. Update it when a plugin's v1 line adds or removes an mcp/*-prompt.md. `topics` lists the framework-agnostic guides here (`bridge guide <topic>`).

topics.orientation: What Bridge does: a short map to relay to the developer (bridge guide orientation)
topics.fit-together: How roles, plans, limits and flags fit together: the rule every decision guide builds on (bridge guide fit-together)
topics.mechanisms: How limits, the upgrade dialog and page customisation work (bridge guide mechanisms)
